propositions: On the agentic path the tool-result message history is re-sent uncached every turn, causing input cost to grow O(N^2) in the number of turns

cache_settings_for sets only two of four available cache breakpoints (anthropic_cache_instructions and anthropic_cache_tool_definitions) and explicitly does not enable anthropic_cache or anthropic_cache_messages
The telemetry predicate warn_if_cache_ineffective fails to detect this inefficiency because the system block hits cache, making cache_read_tokens nonzero and masking the uncached message-tail cost
For agentic execution mode only, anthropic_cache should be enabled on Anthropic and bedrock_cache_messages on Bedrock to cache the message tail, respecting provider-specific key asymmetries
Single-turn paths must remain byte-identical and unchanged to prevent regression

Measured multi-turn agentic runs demonstrate cache_read_tokens growing monotonically with accumulated tool results only after enabling message-tail caching, reducing uncached input from ~97,869 to ~10 tokens across a 9-call sequence
